meta.title: RAJAL — The Art of Quince & Honey
meta.description: Rajal Distillery Quince Honey Liqueur. A family tradition since 1999 — ripe quince, natural meadow honey and a carefully guarded citrus secret.

hero.lead: A family tradition. Nature’s finest ingredients. A secret worth discovering.
hero.imageAlt: A bottle of Rajal Quince Honey Liqueur standing among stones

body: Born from a family tradition dating back to 1999, our liqueur brings together the richness of quince, the gentle sweetness of meadow honey and a carefully guarded citrus secret.
Every bottle carries a part of our story.
story.imageAlt: Rows of quince trees heavy with ripe fruit under a clear autumn sky
story.detailAlt: Ripe quinces hanging from a leafy branch

ingredients.intro: Three elements come together to create an extraordinary liqueur — ripe quince, natural meadow honey and a citrus note we keep to ourselves.

quince.label: I — Quince
quince.title: Fruit with character.
quince.text: Carefully selected for its expressive aroma and natural fruitiness.
quince.imageAlt: A ripe golden quince among leaves on the branch

honey.label: II — Meadow honey
honey.title: Nature’s sweetness.
honey.text: 100% natural meadow honey brings warmth and balance.
honey.imageAlt: Honeybees at work on a golden honeycomb

secret.label: III — The secret
secret.title: One note remains a secret.
secret.text: A subtle touch of citrus completes the composition. Its identity is ours to keep.

body: Creating this liqueur takes time, experience and precision. Behind every bottle is the dedication of a family-owned Serbian distillery.
craft.caption: Meadow honey begins with the bees.
craft.imageAlt: A beekeeper in protective clothing lifting a honeycomb frame from a hive
craft.detailAlt: Gloved hands holding a wooden frame of honeycomb covered with bees

experience.body: Expressive quince, delicate honey notes and a subtle citrus freshness come together in every sip.
experience.imageAlt: A bottle of Rajal Quince Honey Liqueur beside a filled liqueur glass

bottle.body: Produced in deliberately limited annual quantities. Not mass produced. Created to be remembered.
bottle.imageAlt: Rajal Quince Honey Liqueur bottle with its black and gold label, set among rocks

contact.body: Whether you’re looking for a distinctive bottle, a memorable gift, or a premium addition to your hospitality offering, we’d love to hear from you.
contact.privateText: Questions about the liqueur, gifting or availability.
contact.tradeText: For distributors, importers, hotels, restaurants, bars, specialty retailers and corporate gifting.

people.title: A personal touch behind every bottle.
people.intro: Behind RAJAL is a commitment to craftsmanship, carefully chosen ingredients and the tradition of creating something worth sharing.
people.portraitAlt: Portrait of Strahinja Babović, Sales Director of Rajal Distillery
